rationale: Fetch->Store and Parse->Index are routed through the same mid column, so their vertical segments coincide and the drawing shows an H shape with two heads: the reader cannot say which source feeds which target. The collinear branch of _cross reports this under flow.crossings as '1 arrow crossing(s)' with a 0.7 penalty (overall 9.38); a merged shaft is an ambiguity of endpoints, not a crossing, and deserves its own message and a critical severity.
